# Chapter 13 · Likelihood-Based Estimation and Quasi-Likelihood {.unnumbered}
*Maximum Likelihood · KL Projection · Score and Information · QMLE · Likelihood Inference*

관측자료의 parametric probability model 전체를 criterion으로 사용하는 likelihood 접근법을 다룬다. population expected log likelihood, identification, score/Hessian geometry, QMLE와 robust sandwich covariance를 정리한다.

## Chapter Map

::: {.callout-note title="Reading Roadmap"}
- **13.1–13.4** probability models, likelihood, KL geometry, MLE as M/Z estimation
- **13.5–13.7** consistency, score/Hessian/information, asymptotic normality and efficiency
- **13.8–13.10** QMLE, sandwich covariance, Wald/LR/Score inference
- **13.11–13.14** numerical computation, canonical examples, limits, 요약과 연습문제
:::
